entries.entry: Added Quinshon Judkins, Travis Hunter, and Romeo Doubs to the do NOT draft list.
Removed Jordan Mason from the Do NOT Draft list. Still not a target but his ADP has come down and he’s fine to draft in 0 RB builds.
Updated Luther Burden writeup in the “My Targets” chapter with context about his groin injury. He is still a player I am targeting as he slides down draft boards.
Re-ordered do NOT Draft list to be in positional order and sorted by ADP.
Updated the Terry McLaurin writeup in the My Targets chapter following the Stefon Diggs signing. He remains a strong wide receiver target in the back half of Round 4 and the beginning of Round 5.
Updated tier 3 of the wide receivers in the Rookies chapter. Chris Brazzell II was removed and there is now a callout for Ja’Kobi Lane’s path to a significant role early in the season.
Added Michael Pittman Jr. to the My Targets chapter.

Removed Dallas Goedert from the Do NOT Draft chapter. His splits without A.J. Brown on the field have been strong and his price has come down a bit (TE15 on Sleeper, TE14 on Yahoo). I drafted him as the TE15 in round 11 of my first high-stakes draft as the last of 14 teams to take a tight end. He is a good pick in that range and therefore does not belong on the Do NOT Draft list.

Removed Brian Thomas Jr. from the My Targets chapter. Still a player I feel good drafting in the middle rounds, but Parker Washington is the better pick at cost right now in the vast majority of drafts, especially in PPR leagues.
Added Tahj Brooks as a super super deep sleeper in the Sleepers chapter.
Added Marshawn Lloyd as a sleeper in the Sleepers chapter.
Added Josh Jacobs to the Do NOT Draft chapter.
